weapons.name: Anchor Flail
weapons.text: A heavy anchor swings around the ship, battering and shoving foes.

weapons.name: Chainshot
weapons.text: Spinning chained balls that tear through a line of foes and slow them.

weapons.name: Cursed Doubloons
weapons.text: Cursed coins ricochet between foes; kills drop a little extra gold.

weapons.name: Harpoon Gun
weapons.text: Forward tether that slows priority targets.

weapons.name: Lighthouse Lantern
weapons.text: A beam of light sweeps around the ship, burning all along its length.

weapons.name: Long Nine
weapons.text: Long forward line for elite priority shots.

weapons.name: Maelstrom Charge
weapons.text: A lobbed charge opens a whirlpool that drags foes in, then implodes.

weapons.name: Monkey Gunners
weapons.text: Drops a floating barrel turret; its monkey fires at anything in range.

weapons.name: Parrot Squadron
weapons.text: Trained parrots dive-bomb the nearest foes.

weapons.name: Powder Kegs
weapons.text: Drops explosive kegs along your wake.

weapons.name: Ramming Prow
weapons.text: An iron prow: while you boost, it smashes and shoves everything ahead.

weapons.name: Siren Bell
weapons.text: A cursed bell tolls around the ship, hurting and slowing everything near.
